_doc: Base traps and electricity (ADR-0052): generator fuel, the wire that joins pieces into a network, the parts electric pieces are built from, and the schematics for the harder ones. Models by tools/assetgen/blender/generators/base_tech.py (catalog blender_catalogs/base_tech.py), hence the explicit items/base_tech/<id> model ids.

defs.name: Gas Can
defs.description: A red jerrican with gasoline still sloshing in it. Four hours of a generator running flat out; more at a light load.

defs.name: Wire Spool
defs.description: Ten metres of insulated copper wire on a plastic spool. With one in your pack, hold [X] on a generator, a light or a sentry to run a wire from it, then hold [X] on the next piece to connect them.

defs.name: Electrical Parts
defs.description: Switches, a relay, a fuse holder and a tangle of leads pulled out of something that once worked.

defs.name: Work Lamp
defs.description: A caged work-light bulb in a clamp socket. Still good, by the look of the filament.

defs.name: Small Engine
defs.description: A pull-start engine off a mower or a pressure washer. Heavy, oily, and the heart of a generator.

defs.name: Schematic: Generator
defs.description: A Cordon engineer's sketch: an engine, an alternator and a frame of scrap. Loud. Light up a base with it.

defs.name: Schematic: Motion Floodlight
defs.description: Wiring a motion sensor to a floodlight on a pole. Nothing walks up on the wire unseen.

defs.name: Schematic: Nail Sentry
defs.description: A framing nailer, a motion sensor and a pan-and-tilt head. It shoots whatever moves in front of it.
